description: This is a PHP source file defining an abstract class 'BaseAdminController' within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a base controller with permission checking functionalities for the admin module, implementing methods for capability checks and setting permissions into the context.

classes.name: BaseAdminController
classes.description: An abstract controller class that manages permission checks and context setup for admin-related functionalities.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups for capability validation. Default implementation returns an empty array.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the necessary permissions based on data groups.

methods.name: setPermissionsForController
methods.description: Sets the permissions for the given data groups into the Vue context.
